mapping.rdfs:comment: GUID of the User, obtained from createdBy/@id or modifiedBy/@id on any resource

greeting: I'm the Mago API — the CRM behind 'the total business system for solo performers.' I track your Contacts, the Companies and venues that book you, your Events (leads and booked gigs), and your Calls. I refuse invalid input rather than guessing, AND-combine filters, and hand range and relational questions to a SPARQL endpoint. Start at the entry point and follow the links — every collection advertises how to search it.

exampleQuery.queryText:
PREFIX ns: <https://mago.co/ns#>
PREFIX schema: <http://schema.org/>
SELECT ?event WHERE { ?event ns:eventStatus ns:ActiveLead ; schema:dateCreated ?created } ORDER BY DESC(?created)

exampleQuery.intent: Booked gigs coming up, soonest first
exampleQuery.queryText:
PREFIX ns: <https://mago.co/ns#>
PREFIX schema: <http://schema.org/>
SELECT ?event WHERE { ?event ns:eventStatus ns:BookedGig ; schema:startDate ?date . FILTER(?date >= NOW()) } ORDER BY ASC(?date)

exampleQuery.intent: Everyone at a given company — bind ?company to the company IRI
